about.title: About
about.intro: I'm a full stack developer passionate about creating digital experiences that make a difference. With expertise in web and mobile development, I transform ideas into scalable and elegant products.
about.approach: My approach combines user-centered design with the most modern technologies, ensuring solutions that not only work perfectly, but also delight.

timeline.title: Frontend Developer
description: Develop and implement modern, responsive, and optimized web interfaces using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Flutter.

Responsible for the architecture and delivery of complete end-to-end solutions, from landing pages to complex applications with RESTful API integration, authentication systems, and advanced state management.
Collaborate in agile methodologies (Scrum) with active participation in weekly sprints, code reviews, and strategic alignment with multidisciplinary teams.

timeline.title: Children's Programming Instructor
description: Taught programming classes to children, teaching fundamentals of programming logic and JavaScript through playful methodologies and hands-on practical projects.
Created and developed original educational content aligned with Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 11), sparking genuine interest in technology among children.
Promoted accessible and engaging learning, adapting complex concepts to age-appropriate language for children.

timeline.title: Academic Projects Developer
description: Designed and developed a complete virtual store for academic demonstration fair, applying knowledge in e-commerce, UX/UI, and systems architecture.
Led front-end architecture, implementation of advanced features, and technical presentation of the project at institutional academic events.
Conducted remote mentoring sessions via Discord for students interested in or struggling with programming content taught in class.
